en: Colorized vintage view over a river flanked by tree‑lined embankments and grand historic buildings. Several bridges cross the river toward a steep hill with a fortified complex on top and a prominent clock tower (Uhrturm) on the slope. In the top-left corner there is printed red text reading "Grzs. Mur, Schloßberg." The scene is framed like a typical early 20th‑century city postcard.
